# libtmux for Erlang

Native Erlang/OTP 29 library for explicit tmux operations and captured graph queries.

- [README](README.md): installation and executable first program.
- [Guides](docs/guides.md): task-oriented navigation.
- [Fields](docs/fields.md): canonical field and operator reference.
- [Source querying](docs/querying.md): portable criteria, coverage and execution contracts.
- [Operation ownership](docs/jobs.md): waits, completion, cancellation and cleanup.
- [API browser](docs/api.md): build the native reference locally.
- [Project policy](docs/project-policy.md): core/workspace boundaries and OTP runtime dependencies.
- [Current gaps](docs/compatibility.md): control/streams/workspace and delivery status.

Query construction and local snapshot/selection reads perform no tmux I/O.
Opening an endpoint, live get/snapshot/fetch calls and actions perform explicit I/O.
Local selections never load missing relationships. Payload keys never become atoms.
MCP is excluded by project policy. Do not propose an MCP package or server command.
